summary.name: Smodin
summary.one_liner: Smodin is a web-based AI writing platform bundling an AI content detector, AI humanizer, plagiarism checker, rewriter, and AI chat/writer tools.
keywords: check if text is ai generated
use_cases: check an essay for AI-generated text
scan documents for plagiarism before submission
rewrite marketing copy in multiple versions
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a Quick Scan AI content detector: users paste or upload at least 50-100 words and get an overall AI vs human probability plus sentence-level highlights. It names models it says it detects patterns from, including ChatGPT, GPT, Claude, and Gemini. The platform also advertises an AI humanizer, a plagiarism checker, grammar and style tools, a rewriter, and an AI chat for brainstorming and outlining. Testimonials mention these tools but the page gives no detailed technical specifications beyond headline stats such as 99.8% accuracy and 100+ languages.
notable: Quick Scan AI detector with overall AI probability and sentence-level highlights
All-in-one bundle of AI detection, humanizing, plagiarism checking and rewriting
Listed as Smodin Paper, an APA-format AI research paper generator, in a collective AI tools list
caveats: Page says the service is free to try; paid tiers and limits are not detailed on the page
Headline accuracy (99.8%) and detector pass rate figures are self-reported marketing claims
Testimonials and stats are promotional and unverified
